title: König's edge-colouring theorem for bipartite graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a bipartite simple graph on a finite vertex set, and let $\Delta(G)$ denote its maximum degree. Then the chromatic number of the line graph of $G$ — equivalently, the least number of colours needed to colour the edges of $G$ so that no two edges sharing an endpoint receive the same colour — equals $\Delta(G)$.
